RagShortTexts: The Scaligers rallied Verona after tyrant Ezzelino's demise, planting their white ladder.

Variants.Content: Rising to prominence after Ezzelino da Romano's fall in 1259, Mastino I della Scala secured the Podestà of Verona. Bearing a silver ladder crest, the Scaliger lords pacified the Adige valley, turning Verona into a formidable Ghibelline bastion in Veneto.
Under Scaliger sway, fortified river bridges protected merchants from Lombard robber barons, establishing rare urban stability.
